GrowthCred · South Africa

Practical AI. A real person behind it.

I'm Phila Ngwenya. I run GrowthCred from Rosebank, Johannesburg. I help South African owners get what's in their heads written down. Then I put AI to work on the repetitive stuff.

Watch Phila on YouTubePhila on LinkedIn

Meet Phila Ngwenya

I'm GrowthCred's founder and CEO. My job is simple to say. I move owners from briefing their tools over and over to running systems built around how their business works.

I share demos and system ideas on my YouTube channel and on LinkedIn. Come and watch me build.

Experience behind the work

I didn't read about this method. I built it.

I've built five companies with AI. I co-developed an AI system presented at Parliament in Cape Town. I've given seven AI talks at WeWork Johannesburg. And I ran the first Operator Intensive at WeWork Rosebank. It sold out all five seats.

What good training looks like

Bring real work. Write down the context. Build one small workflow. Check the result. Keep what works and measure it. That's the whole method.

A system should move you forward without taking away the judgement that's yours. And I keep demos and client results apart. A worked example in my guides is illustrative, unless I tell you it's a measured, permissioned case study.

Our business details

GrowthCred (Pty) Ltd. Registration 2026/229279/07. Rosebank, Johannesburg, South Africa. Email info@growthcred.co.za, or use the contact page to talk about a workshop or a build.

Results and evidence

I only publish a named client result with permission. MNE Waste, Demure International and TaiAscend agreed to be named. Their stories are on the client stories page, in their words or as the result they reported.

Worked examples stay labelled as illustrative. A method isn't a promise of a result. I keep the two apart on purpose.
